description: Research evidence memory: studies, surveys, experiment steps, corrections.

items.content: Study A (2024) found retrieval-augmented generation reduced hallucination by 40% in a 120-participant pilot; the report flags low confidence due to sample size.
Study B (2025) compared BM25-only against hybrid retrieval over 50k documents; hybrid lifted Recall@5 from 86% to 96% with no latency regression.
The 2025 annual developer survey recorded a response rate of 61% across 840 invited teams.
Correction (2026-01): after removing duplicate ballots, the 2025 annual developer survey response rate is 58% (818 valid teams).
The staged rollout of the evaluation harness was internally codenamed Project Cedar.
Correction (2026-03): Project Cedar was renamed to Project Redwood after the codename collision was found; all dashboards now show Redwood.
Experiment alpha step 1: freeze the corpus snapshot so every run sees identical documents.
Experiment alpha step 2: calibrate the scorer on the frozen corpus before any treatment run (never after).
Experiment alpha step 3: only then execute the treatment arm and record effect sizes with bootstrap confidence intervals.
The literature review folder contains 212 papers, 40 of which were marked irrelevant in the first pass.
The citation export format was switched from BibTeX to CSL-JSON for the shared library.
A pre-print on embedding drift was bookmarked for later review; it has not been read or validated.
